legend.hazard.slopeNote: Building code slope grades; click to see the grade
legend.hazard.aspectNote: Direction the slope faces, in 8 directions; click to see the direction
legend.hazard.fireEventNote: Casualties = larger red dot with a bold outline (other dots have only a faint outline)
legend.hazard.hydrantCoverage: Public data only for Taipei and Kaohsiung
legend.hazard.isochroneNote: Conservative estimate on the driving network; fire-engine siren priority is not counted (actual reach is slightly larger)
legend.hazard.bssLine3: New Taipei official end-to-end approximate axis only (206)
legend.hazard.bssRights: Bulk reuse rights from BSS are unconfirmed (HOLD; site owner's research only, not for public distribution)
legend.hazard.bssNote1: v5: the 26,188 entries are source records, not a de-duplicated bridge count; 2,912 have a point but no line (1,731 with multiple candidates to re-check, 1,181 with no candidate).
legend.hazard.bssNote2: v4 imagery spot-check of 300 entries: 103 supported, 2 contradicted, 195 undetermined; an overall error rate below 3% is not yet demonstrated.
legend.hazard.bssNote3: {rights}; work in progress, not verified real bridges or road network.
legend.hazard.bssLineNote: Colored by v5 class. Of the 23,276 lines, OSM bridge entities are full-length geometry (not clipped to the registered extent) and network-inferred ones are fixed short schematic lines. None are reviewed identities, engineering bridge lengths or a road network; the "Traffic type" filter still uses the existing classes.
legend.hazard.bssPointNote: Positions are register reference points, not bridge ends or road network nodes; shown from zoom 10.
legend.hazard.brApproach: At-grade approach (not removed, faint dashed line)
legend.hazard.brMix: 73 bridges = 26 manually reviewed + 47 auto-selected; segment groups of auto-selected bridges are machine-matched, so rankings are for reference only.
legend.hazard.brRouteNote: Only the 3 representative origin–destination pairs with the largest registered-population weight are drawn; they are not necessarily the longest detours.
legend.hazard.brDecayTitle: Distance-decayed (mean trip 20 min): average extra seconds
legend.hazard.brDecayNote: Unit: seconds. Each village's color = how many seconds longer, on average, trips take "starting from here" to other villages; nearby destinations weigh more and distant ones are discounted (τ = 20 min, assumed); unaffected destinations count as 0 s.
legend.hazard.brMetricShare: Share of population at affected destinations
legend.hazard.brOriginNote: Origin view: each village's color = how much slower trips are on average "starting from here" to elsewhere. Click a village to switch to the destination view.
legend.hazard.brDestTitle: Destination view: average extra time of the district
legend.hazard.brDestNoImpact: No affected destinations (extra time does not exceed 60 s; not 0)
legend.hazard.brDestUnreach: Unreachable (no route after removal; not treated as a very large time)
legend.hazard.brDestNote: Destination view: color = how much slower trips "to there" get, counting affected destinations only; data is at district level, so a district shares one color. Click empty space or "Back to origin view" to return.
legend.hazard.brDestUniformNote: Destination detail is the unweighted version (no distance-decayed data exists), so its basis differs from the distance-decayed village color scale.
legend.hazard.brFooter: Select a bridge first, then turn on villages or alternative routes. Site owner only (BSS license on HOLD).
legend.hazard.mountainSize: Dot size = total personnel dispatched (fire, police, national park, forestry, civilian)
legend.hazard.soilNotInvestigated: Not surveyed (officially stated; not the same as low potential)
legend.hazard.soilNoData: No data (category missing in the source; not filled, not counted as not surveyed)
legend.hazard.soilNote: High/medium/low are official composite classes, not measured values; for individual sites they are for preliminary assessment only and are not an engineering safety determination.
legend.hazard.soilRights: Source: Geological Survey and Mining Management Agency, Ministry of Economic Affairs. Site owner's research only; reuse terms unconfirmed (RIGHTS_HOLD_REUSE_TERMS_UNCONFIRMED).
legend.hazard.weakZeroRow: Thickness {zero} = no weak layer in this depth band (not filled)
legend.hazard.weakNote: Threshold {threshold}; each class = 20% of the thickness of that depth band. The three depth bands correspond to different reference excavation depths; shown at zoom {zoom} and above.
legend.hazard.monitorRow: Locations of the 11 stations listed on the official map portal
legend.hazard.monitorNote: Locations and names only, not real-time observations; check the official page for monitoring data.
legend.hazard.eqReplayNote1: Dot = station (size by PGA) · Square = 2.5 km intensity grid · Area = township intensity
legend.hazard.eqReplayNote2: The wavefront expands from the epicenter at the S-wave speed of 3.5 km/s
legend.hazard.typForecast: Forecast track (blue dashed line / hollow dots)
legend.hazard.typCurrent: Current position (yellow ring; click for details)
legend.hazard.alertPulse: Pulsing ring = Severe or above and still in effect
legend.hazard.newsNote: Coordinates = township representative point (not the event location)
legend.hazard.globalOutline: Light outline = AI preliminary assessment; dark outline = researched and published. All importance levels are kept.
legend.hazard.globalNote: Points may be source-supported event locations or city/country representative centers; a representative point is not an exact occurrence coordinate (see the popup). Different events at the same location are shown side by side; numbered dots expand when clicked. Arcs only indicate links between cross-border events, with no direction of movement or time order.
legend.hazard.nuclearNote1: ⚠️ High dose + stale = sensor offline, not a real nuclear accident
legend.hazard.erTitle: ER crowding (waiting for a general bed)
legend.hazard.erIcu: ⚪ White outline = patients waiting for an ICU bed
legend.hazard.erCalib: Levels calibrated on 37 days of wait_general_cnt history
legend.hazard.typAllNote: With "All" selected, each storm is drawn from one agency only (CWA > JMA > JTWC). Wind radii come from CWA only.
legend.hazard.typAgencyEmpty: No agency forecast at this point in time.
legend.hazard.typAgencyNote: Only each agency's latest version at the selected time is drawn; issue times are Taiwan time. Source: NCDR (National Science and Technology Center for Disaster Reduction).
